name: Therese Conrad
original_name: テレーゼ・コンラート
source:
Therese is the girl from a rich family that [url=/c1666]Claude[/url] meets when he first comes to Engelbourg. Therese possesses the power to hear the thoughts of others who are near her. However, as a result of this power, she is no longer able to speak and uses a bell to communicate with people. She has a very sweet personality and does get on well with other people.

[Edited from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/08/22/vanitas-no-hitsuji-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
